name: macro-atlas-20260101t000000z-0000000
title: Macro Atlas: bulk files
description: Every Series of this Release that may be redistributed, at its native frequency and not rounded: the Observations as one long table in three formats, and every version held of each Period. The same rows are also given by licence class. A Series that may be shown but not handed out, and a Withheld Series, are in no file.
